original_dsl:
CHOICES ambient-cycle-choice
    OPTION option_1 "吹起微风"
    OPTION option_2 "飘落树叶"
    OPTION option_3 "保持宁静"
repaired_dsl:
TEXT ambient_feedback "环境保持宁静" x=260 y=80 z=5 vis=true
CHOICES ambient_cycle_choice
    OPTION option_1 "吹起微风"
        TEXT_SET ambient_feedback "微风吹起"
        ANIM_IN ambient_feedback fade ms=300 dir=left
    OPTION option_2 "飘落树叶"
        TEXT_SET ambient_feedback "树叶飘落"
        ANIM_IN ambient_feedback fade ms=300 dir=down
    OPTION option_3 "保持宁静"
        TEXT_SET ambient_feedback "环境保持宁静"
        ANIM_IN ambient_feedback fade ms=200
repair_reason: Replaced bare unhandled signals with visible option effects and removed the runtime-hostile repeat loop so the choice remains executable in validation.
audit_reason_before: The three visible options are correct, but a one-shot CHOICES does not implement the explicit repeated-choice lifecycle. DeepSeek's candidate also only duplicates the menu once rather than constructing a valid repeatable flow; this sample needs an actual loop or jump-back design with grounded option effects.
intent_after: 做一个环境选择流程，让玩家决定接下来吹起微风、飘落树叶还是保持宁静；每个选项都要有可见反馈。

judgment.why: 修改后 DSL 比原始 DSL 好：原始 DSL 只有一行 CHOICES 无任何反馈，修改后为每个选项添加了 TEXT_SET 和 ANIM_IN 可见反馈，修复了主要问题。但仍有不足：CHOICES 未设 block=true，玩家点击后菜单不消失，反馈文本与菜单重叠，交互不干净；且 TASK 隐含玩家可多次选择（'决定接下来'），当前无循环或跳转机制，只能选一次。评分 7 分，需要人工复核。
judgment.suggested_better_dsl:
TEXT ambient_feedback "环境保持宁静" x=260 y=80 z=5 vis=true
LOOP
    CHOICES ambient_cycle_choice block=true
        OPTION option_1 "吹起微风"
            TEXT_SET ambient_feedback "微风吹起"
            ANIM_IN ambient_feedback fade ms=300 dir=left
        OPTION option_2 "飘落树叶"
            TEXT_SET ambient_feedback "树叶飘落"
            ANIM_IN ambient_feedback fade ms=300 dir=down
        OPTION option_3 "保持宁静"
            TEXT_SET ambient_feedback "环境保持宁静"
            ANIM_IN ambient_feedback fade ms=200
    WAIT 2000
    CONTINUE
remaining_issues: TASK 要求每个选项都有可见反馈，但 CHOICES 本身没有设置 block=true，玩家点击后菜单不会消失，反馈文本与菜单同时可见，交互流程不完整
TASK 未明确要求循环，但原意图是重复选择，当前 DSL 只做了一次选择，没有提供再次选择或退出机制，与 TASK 的'决定接下来'的持续决策语义有差距

original_dsl:
VAR wardrobe_reveal_idx = 0
IMAGE cloth_reveal "衣物01" animation={"entry":{"animId":"弹入"}} x=220 y=260 w=120 h=140 z=3 vis=true
LOOP wardrobe_reveal_idx < 3
    ANIM_IN cloth_reveal scaleIn ms=300
    WAIT 500
    VAR wardrobe_reveal_idx + 1
repaired_dsl:
VAR wardrobe_reveal_idx = 0
VAR wardrobe_reveal_interrupted = false
IF wardrobe_reveal_interrupted == false
    IMAGE cloth_reveal_1 "衣物01" animation={"entry":{"animId":"弹入"}} x=160 y=260 w=100 h=120 z=3 vis=true
    VAR wardrobe_reveal_idx + 1
    WAIT 500
IF wardrobe_reveal_interrupted == false
    IMAGE cloth_reveal_2 "衣物01" animation={"entry":{"animId":"弹入"}} x=320 y=260 w=100 h=120 z=3 vis=true
    VAR wardrobe_reveal_idx + 1
    WAIT 500
IF wardrobe_reveal_interrupted == false
    IMAGE cloth_reveal_3 "衣物01" animation={"entry":{"animId":"弹入"}} x=480 y=260 w=100 h=120 z=3 vis=true
    VAR wardrobe_reveal_idx + 1
IF wardrobe_reveal_idx >= 3
    RETURN

ON wardrobe_interrupt "中断揭示"
    VAR wardrobe_reveal_interrupted = true
repair_reason: Grounded the three reveals in the single available clothing asset, added an explicit interrupt signal, and kept the sequential reveal/stop behavior.
audit_reason_before: Gold reruns ANIM_IN on one image that starts visible and is never hidden or replaced, so it does not genuinely reveal clothing resources one by one during the three iterations.
intent_after: 做一个可中断揭示流程：资产池只有衣物01时，将同一衣物图作为三个记忆揭示位依次弹入；收到 wardrobe_interrupt 时中断，索引达到3时停止。

judgment.why: 修改后DSL将同一衣物图作为三个独立揭示位，并添加了中断信号和中断变量，基本实现了TASK要求的可中断揭示流程。但三个IMAGE的animation入口同时触发，WAIT仅控制变量递增和后续IF判断，未真正实现依次弹入的动画时序，存在轻微语义缺口。整体修复明显优于原版，适合作为训练样本，但需人工确认动画时序是否满足'依次弹入'。
judgment.suggested_better_dsl:
VAR wardrobe_reveal_idx = 0
VAR wardrobe_reveal_interrupted = false

IMAGE cloth_reveal_1 "衣物01" x=160 y=260 w=100 h=120 z=3 vis=false
IMAGE cloth_reveal_2 "衣物01" x=320 y=260 w=100 h=120 z=3 vis=false
IMAGE cloth_reveal_3 "衣物01" x=480 y=260 w=100 h=120 z=3 vis=false

AUTO "揭示流程"
    IF wardrobe_reveal_interrupted == true
        RETURN
    IF wardrobe_reveal_idx == 0
        STYLE cloth_reveal_1 {"display":"block"}
        ANIM_IN cloth_reveal_1 scaleIn ms=300
        WAIT 500
        VAR wardrobe_reveal_idx + 1
    IF wardrobe_reveal_interrupted == true
        RETURN
    IF wardrobe_reveal_idx == 1
        STYLE cloth_reveal_2 {"display":"block"}
        ANIM_IN cloth_reveal_2 scaleIn ms=300
        WAIT 500
        VAR wardrobe_reveal_idx + 1
    IF wardrobe_reveal_interrupted == true
        RETURN
    IF wardrobe_reveal_idx == 2
        STYLE cloth_reveal_3 {"display":"block"}
        ANIM_IN cloth_reveal_3 scaleIn ms=300
        WAIT 500
        VAR wardrobe_reveal_idx + 1
    IF wardrobe_reveal_idx >= 3
        RETURN

ON wardrobe_interrupt "中断揭示"
    VAR wardrobe_reveal_interrupted = true
remaining_issues: 三个揭示位使用相同的动画'弹入'，但TASK要求'依次弹入'，当前三个IMAGE同时创建并播放动画，没有真正的先后顺序，而是靠WAIT间隔，但动画入口同时触发，视觉上可能不是依次弹入而是同时弹入。
